name: Fizz Fold
summary: A soda product card that bursts open when you tap the can, with flavours, sizes and add to cart
about: An interactive product card for a soft drink. The can floats and leans toward your pointer in 3D; tap it and it squashes, sprays droplets and tips back while the card unfolds to show the flavour, nutrition, size, quantity and an Add to cart button, piece by piece. Picking a flavour spins the can and repaints the whole card. Good for a drink shop, a product launch or a brand page.
how: Move the pointer over the can to tilt it; press it and it squashes like a soft can.
Tap the can (or press Enter on it): droplets burst out, bubbles rise and the details slide in one after another.
Choose a flavour to spin the can and recolour the card, then pick a size and quantity; the price updates.
Press Add to cart to see adding, then added, and the cart count pops; close with the × button, the can or Escape.
